nom: Neutrogena Collagen Bank Vitamin C Face Serum Fragrance Free

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are mostly positive, reporting no irritation from the 15% vitamin C concentration, though one reviewer specifically warns that sensitive skin should be cautious since it broke her out.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin describe their dry patches clearing up and skin feeling softer and more plump after several weeks of use.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one also describing it as acne-prone, report improved texture and hydration without new breakouts or excess oil.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s and 50s use the serum for dullness, discoloration and fine lines, generally reporting a gradual brightening and firmer feel rather than dramatic change.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it against aging report a subtle brightening and youthful glow, including a 43-year-old citing reduced dullness and discoloration and a 54-year-old fading hyperpigmentation and improving skin texture; effects are generally described as gradual rather than dramatic.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry or dehydrated skin, report the serum leaves skin more hydrated, plump and less flaky; one reviewer noted a day or two of mild dryness that resolved with a heavier moisturizer.
concerns.spots: Reviewers using it for dark spots, sun spots or post-breakout marks report gradual fading and a more even tone after several weeks, with some spots improving faster than others.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: most reviewers, including several with combination or acne-prone skin, say it does not cause breakouts and even helps keep pores clear, while a handful describe their skin breaking out shortly after starting to use it, particularly at the 15% vitamin C concentration.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers describe the serum as non-greasy and say it does not add shine, including one with combination skin who noted less midday oil breakthrough; one reviewer without oily skin found it made her face look oily and break out slightly.

aspects.libelle: Can feel sticky or tacky before absorbing
Good value for a drugstore price

extraits.texte: Received this free from HomeTesterClub in exchange for my honest opinion and review-Not good for me. It irritated and broke my skin out almost immediately. It smelled so sour, like inside of a tin can and old musty dust. It was tacky on the skin as well. I reported this and was asked to discontinue use. So I did. Maybe it's good for others?!

I noticed a difference in the brightness of my skin. However, this product contains enough vitamin c to where people with sensitive skin should be careful. This product broke me out, so just be mindful of the high percentage of vitamin c. If your skin can tolerate it then it's a great product. Just not for me.

extraits.titre: Glowy results for dry, dehydrated skin
extraits.texte: I was gifted the Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum, and I've been incorporating it into my skincare routine. I apply it right after toner and before my moisturizer, just a few drops pressed into the skin and spread. For reference, I have dry, dehydrated skin that tends to soak up everything I use. My texture is mostly smooth, though I do have a bit of roughness on one cheek, along with some sun spots. This doesn't soak in. It gradually nourishes my skin. It's also fragrance free! After consistent use, I improvement in those areas! More glowy and plump skin. It's sold me on using vitamin C! For reference, I'm almost 40.

I received the Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum for free. After using it for 4 weeks morning and night I noticed my dry skin improved and felt softer. My sun spots got lighter in some areas while other areas need more time for improvement. This serum is lightweight and the skin absorbs it well. It is not oily. Overall I like this product.

extraits.titre: Best serum I've been able to stick with.
extraits.texte: This is the first serum of any kind that I have actually seen results with. My skin can be sensitive to actives , especially retinols, many times causing me to discontinue use. I experienced no irritation with this and the bonus was seeing and feeling result within a week. Smoother brighter and plumper skin with less texture. I've also noticed improved moisture balance and less oil breakthrough. Even my makeup looks better while the improvement in my skin texture has me using less base product. I've found using a milky toner, then the C serum, followed by a peptide moisturizer tolock everything in both morning and night is perfectly agreeing with my skin. I am 54 with combination skin.

As long as you are consistent with this, it works great! It's a heavier serum but it absorbs extremely well and doesn't burn my skin like other Vitamin C serums have. It also doesn't clog my pores which I was super concerned about. I have combination skin/acne prone skin and I have definitely seen the change of texture in my skin, and it feeling more hydrated and bright. I couple it with Neutrogenas Hydro Boost Moisturizer that has SPF 25 in it and it truly melts into my skin!
